literal_meaning: মুখের উপর ঢাকনা (lid on the face/mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: To be excessively talkative; to argue or debate persistently
similar_in_english: To run off at the mouth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মুখের উপর চোপা, সবসময় তর্ক করে।
মিটিংয়ে তার বাচালতা সবাইকে বিরক্ত করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is all mouth and can't stop arguing.
Her talkativeness annoyed everyone in the meeting.
note: Refers to someone whose speech is uncontrollable, like a pot without a lid.
